comparison.claim: The candidate confirms the prior warm result within run-to-run noise; it is not a material speedup claim.

limitations: One steady warm confirmation on one authenticated live session is not a latency distribution.
The screenshot proves visible populated UI, not interaction or scroll latency.
The phase intervals identify optimization targets but do not by themselves attribute CPU cost.
